description: This Java class 'GetFilterBsonVisitor' creates MongoDB BSON filter objects based on field expressions, supporting authorization considerations. It implements the 'FilterFieldExpressionVisitor' interface and extends 'AbstractFieldBsonCreator' to generate BSON filters for querying MongoDB based on various expression types such as attributes, feature IDs, and pointers.

classes.name: GetFilterBsonVisitor
classes.description: Creates MongoDB BSON filters from field expressions, handling authorization and different field types.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Static method to create a BSON filter from an expression with a predicate function and optional authorization IDs.

methods.name: sudoApply
methods.description: Static method to create a BSON filter from an expression without authorization restrictions.

methods.name: visitAttribute
methods.description: Creates a BSON filter for an attribute key.

methods.name: visitFeatureIdProperty
methods.description: Creates a BSON filter for a feature ID and property.

methods.name: visitPointer
methods.description: Creates a BSON filter for a pointer.

methods.name: visitRootLevelField
methods.description: Creates a BSON filter for a root level field name.
